fields.description: Issue includes commentary and local political reporting on Miami Safety Director Andrew J. Kavanaugh (including speculation about federal "G-man" connections) and a stated crackdown on drunken drivers and traffic violations as part of a safety campaign. Articles allege questionable practices involving the Federal Savings & Loan Association of Miami and the J. M. Lipton Insurance Agency, and discuss anticipated federal grand jury scrutiny of bankruptcy-related dealings. The paper also reports results of Miami Life's "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest (Eunice Chandler named winner) and promotes ongoing beauty-contest voting, alongside entertainment and sports items including Florida racing dates, handicapping tips, and wrestling promotion news.
